hero.headline: I build secure Laravel backends that your business can
hero.intro: Hi, I'm Mishkatul Islam, a PHP / Laravel backend developer with 2+ years shipping SaaS, fintech and ecommerce platforms: payment gateways, multi-role dashboards and REST APIs for web and mobile apps.

stats.label: apps deployed on Linux, VPS & cPanel

services.title: What I can build for you
services.subtitle: From a brand-new Laravel app to fixing a bug on your live site — here is how I can help your business.

items.title: Laravel web apps & SaaS
items.text: Booking systems, ecommerce stores and SaaS platforms with separate dashboards for Admin, Vendor and Manager.

items.title: REST APIs for web & mobile
items.text: Clean, documented APIs that your website and mobile app can use — tested in Postman and ready for your frontend team.

items.title: Payment gateway integration
items.text: Secure checkout with SSLCommerz, Stripe, PayPal and cash on delivery — even several gateways in one app.

items.title: Login, OTP & user roles
items.text: Mobile OTP login, multi-role authentication and permissions, so every user sees only what they should.

items.title: Deployment & server setup
items.text: I put your app live on a Linux VPS, cPanel, aaPanel or Hestia — with clear, repeatable rollout steps.

items.title: Bug fixing & speed-ups
items.text: Fast fixes for live production issues, plus MySQL schema and query tuning when your app gets slow.

work.title: Real products, live in the market
work.subtitle: I built and maintained the backend for these four products at AppDevs. All of them are live on CodeCanyon (Envato Market) — open any one and see it yourself.

items.title: adMart
items.subtitle: Online grocery shopping, eCommerce & pharmacy solution
items.description: A complete grocery and pharmacy store with live order tracking and a dedicated Driver Panel for end-to-end delivery.

items.title: SalonHub
items.subtitle: Spa & salon booking management — full solution
items.description: Covers the full booking lifecycle, with separate dashboards for Admin, Vendor and Manager.

items.title: DoctorHub
items.subtitle: Hospital, doctor & patient booking — full solution
items.description: Role-based panels for hospitals and vendors, with patient appointments and home-healthcare booking.

items.title: XTream
items.subtitle: Live sports & entertainment streaming SaaS
items.description: Live and highlight streaming with subscriptions, built for international audiences.

bullets: Built and maintained **4 core backend systems** with multiple payment-gateway integrations and multi-role access for Admin, Vendor and Manager dashboards.
Deployed and maintained **50+ projects** on Linux, VPS, cPanel, aaPanel and Hestia, standardizing rollout steps to reduce deployment issues.
Debugged production incidents in real time, cutting recurring bug reports **from 40% to 20%**.
Designed and documented REST APIs used by web and mobile clients.
Developed features across Laravel applications for real estate, hotel management, ERP and accounting.
Contributed to government projects, working with senior developers to meet delivery timelines.
